lead: Fra Bartolomeo or Bartolommeo, O.P., also known as Bartolommeo di Pagholo, Bartolommeo di San Marco, Bartolomeo di Paolo di Jacopo del Fattorino, and his original nickname Baccio della Porta, was an Italian Renaissance painter of religious subjects.
paras: He spent all his career in Florence until his mid-forties, when he travelled to work in various cities, as far south as Rome.
